newsitem.title: USA: Apple seen losing research scientists - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Apple seen losing research scientists - WSJ.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc has seen more of its top researchers leave the company and a reduction in research projects, after its recent budget-cutting plans, the Wall Street Journal said in Monday's electronic edition.
Three of Apple's top scientists -- Don Norman, Gursharan Sidhu and Alan Kay -- have all left the company recently, the paper said.

An Apple insider estimated the company's long-term research budget was cut to $12 million from $50 million, it said. It closed several long-term projects, including one focused on television sets with personal computers, it said.
